claims: C1 the developer authority level is assigned to Model Spec 'developer' sections
C2 the developer authority level is assigned to developer messages

concepts.name: developer_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level named 'developer' in the Model Spec's ordered hierarchy of authority levels

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: which of two authority levels is the higher one in the Model Spec's ordered hierarchy

concepts.name: developer_section
concepts.gloss: a section of the Model Spec marked as a 'developer' section

concepts.name: developer_message
concepts.gloss: a message from a developer in the conversation

ontology.gloss: S is a Model Spec 'developer' section and therefore carries the developer authority level
M is a developer message and therefore carries the developer authority level
